fato_historico: 1941: Holocaust: Fifteen hundred Jews from Pidhaytsi are sent by Nazis to Bełżec extermination camp.
energia_do_dia: Today, your gentle spirit may feel the weight of history, reminding you of the profound importance of kindness and the resilience of the human soul. It is a good time to channel your empathy into creative outlets. Consider how even the smallest act of grace can brighten the collective experience and bring healing to your sensitive heart.
frase_do_dia: Let your kindness be a beacon that guides others through the darkest nights.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual discovery and the hidden wisdom within your inner world.
conselho: Practice self-care and surround yourself with peaceful, uplifting energy throughout the day.
